Headline: #76 Diversey Temporary Reroute near Diversey/Cicero
ShortDescription: 76 Diversey buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Diversey/Cicero.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#76 Diversey buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Diversey/Cicero.
